## Requirements

Building the API client library requires:

1. Java 17+
2. Maven/Gradle

## Installation

To install the API client library to your local Maven repository, simply execute:

```shell
mvn clean install
```

To deploy it to a remote Maven repository instead, configure the settings of the repository and execute:

```shell
mvn clean deploy
```

Refer to the [OSSRH Guide](http://central.sonatype.org/pages/ossrh-guide.html) for more information.

### Maven users

Add this dependency to your project's POM:

```xml
<dependency>
  <groupId>com.acos</groupId>
  <artifactId>architect-career-api-sdk</artifactId>
  <version>0.0.1</version>
  <scope>compile</scope>
</dependency>
```

### Gradle users

Add this dependency to your project's build file:

```groovy
  repositories {
    mavenCentral()     // Needed if the 'architect-career-api-sdk' jar has been published to maven central.
    mavenLocal()       // Needed if the 'architect-career-api-sdk' jar has been published to the local maven repo.
  }

  dependencies {
     implementation "com.acos:architect-career-api-sdk:0.0.1"
  }
```

### Others

At first generate the JAR by executing:

```shell
mvn clean package
```

Then manually install the following JARs:

- `target/architect-career-api-sdk-0.0.1.jar`
- `target/lib/*.jar`

    public static void main(String[] args) {
        ApiClient defaultClient = new ApiClient();
        defaultClient.setBasePath("http://127.0.0.1:8080");
        
        // Configure HTTP bearer authorization: bearer-jwt
        HttpBearerAuth bearer-jwt = (HttpBearerAuth) defaultClient.getAuthentication("bearer-jwt");
        bearer-jwt.setBearerToken("BEARER TOKEN");

        AiIntegrationApi apiInstance = new AiIntegrationApi(defaultClient);
        try {
            AiPlatformHealthApiResponse result = apiInstance.getHealth();
            System.out.println(result);
        } catch (HttpStatusCodeException e) {
